integrity: Analytical infinite-period proof with exact-rational IVT witness. A standalone checker independently tests supporting identities; no finite experiment is asserted to certify the infinite exclusion.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive populations, k=1 and host growth lambda>1 only.
The existence witness at lambda=5 does not imply period seven for every lambda or stability of the orbit.
The full 2019 generalized-recurrence article could not be inspected; an earlier equivalence remains a specific literature risk.
The original printed May journal issue gives October 1978 without a day; indexed metadata gives 1978-10-01.
title: The sharp seven-step periodicity gap in May's geometric-series host–parasitoid map
